2116146031696167378.en_summary: Stephanie Link says $AMZN reaction seems a bit extreme on actual results even if whispers weren't met. AWS +39% was 6th consecutive quarter of acceleration, best since 4Q 2021, backlog tripled, next 2 years guide of 40% at 40% operating margin. Retail demand remains strong, tough Prime Day comp. Ads + double digits. 15x EPS.
2116146031696167378.zh_summary: Stephanie Link 表示 $AMZN 的反應對實際結果而言有點極端，即使未達市場傳聞。AWS +39% 是連續第 6 季加速，自 2021 年第四季以來最佳，積壓訂單翻三倍，未來兩年指引 40% 增長且 40% 營運利潤率。零售需求依然強勁，Prime Day 比較基數艱難。廣告雙位數增長。15 倍 EPS。

ticker_notes.AMZN: 反應極端，AWS 加速且未來指引強，15x EPS
